verdict.rationale: Audience export is a fair question for an email marketing platform, but the evidence pack never documents exporting contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, or suppression lists in an open format. The Marketing Emails API retrieves email assets and send statistics, not the audience. Segment exclusion and unengaged-contact suppression are sending controls, not export.

support.subject: As a founder, I can export my entire audience — contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, and suppression list — in an open format, self-serve
